title: A malformed Bill To id in a Public API list filter returns an error
custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • Use a Public API key for the test organization, the Public API documentation, and a tool that sends API requests.
custom_steps:
1. Send GET for the work order list through the Public API with the Bill To filter set to "abc".
  2. Send GET for the invoice list through the Public API with the Bill To filter set to "abc".
custom_expected:
Expected Result

Step 1:

  • The response is an error.
  • No list of work orders is returned.

Step 2:

  • The response is an error.
  • No list of invoices is returned.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)
